faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Thrissur District Court Contract Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Contract Driver post is 26th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Contract Driver position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Contract Driver post will receive a salary of Rs. 24,590 per month. This is a fixed contractual salary as per the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the Contract Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be retired from courts, similar departments, or other government departments to be eligible for the Contract Driver position. Specific experience details might be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Contract Driver post is 62 years. There is no minimum age limit specified, but candidates must be retired government employees.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Contract Driver post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Contract Driver post in the Thrissur District Court. This is a single opening as per the advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Contract Driver post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Contract Driver post. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Contract Driver role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Contract Driver post will be based on merit, considering the candidate's experience and qualifications. Shortlisted candidates will be notified.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. Always refer to the official PDF for complete details.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates, along with the filled application form.
